subject: Rehearsal run: MAP + canary playbook for Novamed rollouts
messages:
From: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@novamed.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Ops <ops@novamed.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature rehearsal + MAP alignment (Novamed)

Hannah,

Great to be moving into implementation — thank you and congrats on getting the contract across the line. The Novamed ops team is pushing to run a short "rehearsal" in July to validate the MAP and canary gates before the full cutover. Aim: verify routing policies, smoke canary, and two training sessions for key SRE/CS staff.

I attached a draft MAP (MAP_Novamed_v1.2.xlsx) and a short checklist we normally use for canary rehearsals. High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the canary approach (10% traffic -> validation window -> 50% -> full)
- Lock two 90-minute training slots for July 12 and July 19 (US-PDT preferred)
- Confirm data retention / audit log export for the rehearsal window (48h retention snapshot)

Can you propose an internal runbook and delta items we should expect during the rehearsal? We'll need a quick signoff sheet after the rehearsal to move to the staged rollout.

Thanks,
Eleanor
Eleanor Price
Head of Integrations, Novamed Health
E: eleanor.price@novamed.com
A: Novamed HQ — 4th Floor, Boston

Attachments: MAP_Novamed_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), canary-checklist-rehearsal.pdf (pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@novamed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature rehearsal + MAP alignment (Novamed)

Eleanor — thanks for the clear asks and for attaching the MAP. We can absolutely run a rehearsal week. Quick notes from our side:

- Canary approach: we recommend a smoke canary with synthetic traffic + small production shadow (10 users) followed by progressive ramping. We have a ready "canary gate" task list we can replay.
- Training: we can provide two 90-minute sessions — one for SRE (deep ops + rollback playbook) and one for CS (support flows + acceptance gates). July 12 & July 19 work for us right now; we'll propose times after I confirm with Marcus and Laura.
- Audits: export snapshots are doable. We will provide an HMAC-signed audit bundle and a short retention policy note.

I'll circulate a rehearsal runbook (internal) and a public-facing one-pager for Novamed by EOD Wednesday. For transparency, looping in Marcus and Laura to scope runbook ownership and the training deck.

Next steps: Marcus will own the canary checklist execution; Laura will own training ops; Priyom will coordinate the MAP timeline and acceptance criteria.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0143

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature rehearsal + MAP alignment (Novamed)

Folks — I dug into the MAP and the attached checklist. Two quick operational clarifications before I author the rehearsal runbook:

1) Traffic shaping: do we have a preferred route rule for the rehearsal? Novamed asked for a 10% production route, but I'd prefer running the smoke with synthetic traffic + a small live cohort routed to a "canary stack" to avoid user experience disruptions. Suggest: synthetic load (20 min) -> live cohort (10 users) for 1 hour -> automated validation.

2) KV cache and seed state: Novamed's integration uses session presigning that relies on cached model warm state. We'll need a seed KV snapshot to match production warm start time; otherwise latency outliers will blow the canary metric. Priyom — can you check whether the customer wants a warm snapshot or are we doing a cold start rehearsal?

I'll draft a runbook with gates: preflight checklist, smoke validation metrics (p50/p95 latency, error rate, token failure rate), rollback triggers, and post-mortem artifacts. Target: send draft runbook Wednesday 11:00 PDT.

Attachments: canary-checklist-rehearsal.pdf

— Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@novamed.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 27 Jun 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature rehearsal + MAP alignment (Novamed)

Eleanor — quick answer on warm vs cold: Novamed prefers a warm start rehearsal to validate latency SLAs under realistic cached conditions. I'll set the seed KV snapshot from a low-traffic window and share the snapshot identifier and instructions in the runbook.

Training slots: Confirming July 12, 10:00–11:30 PDT for SRE run-through and July 19, 13:00–14:30 PDT for CS + product acceptance. Laura, Vanessa — please prepare the training-corridor-slides.pptx and include a 20-minute hands-on session for the operators.

Acceptance criteria (proposed for the MAP rehearsal):
- p50 latency <= 120ms; p95 < 350ms
- Error rate < 0.3% over the 1-hour live cohort window
- No data leakage events; audit bundle generated within 30m of rehearsal end
- Successful rollback within 15 minutes if any gate fails

I'll also create a simple signoff artifact (one-page) that Eleanor can approve post-rehearsal.

— Priyom
Principal PM, Implementation | Redwood Inference
From: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@novamed.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature rehearsal + MAP alignment (Novamed)

Team — this looks great and aligns with our internal risk appetite. Confirming:
- Rehearsal window: July 12 (SRE) & July 19 (CS) — slots accepted
- Canary approach: synthetic + 10 live users -> progressive ramp OK
- Acceptance criteria: agreed (we'll watch the p95 closely)
- Novamed will sign the one-page signoff immediately after the rehearsal if gates are green.

Please go ahead with the rehearsal runbook and training deck. We'll share a short operations contact list (phone + slack handles) separately.

Eleanor
Head of Integrations, Novamed Health
Attachments: training-corridor-slides.pptx (pptx)
